wpa_driver_roboswitch_set_param(): sep = drv->ifname + os_strlen(drv->ifname); *sep = '.'; can write past the last valid string byte and leave drv->ifname unterminated for the duration of the l2_packet_init() call if the interface name occupies the full IFNAMSIZ+1 buffer (edge case, exact-max-length ifname required to trigger).
